concepts.def: Loss of electrons, or gain of oxygen.
Gain of electrons, or loss of oxygen.
A reaction in which oxidation and reduction happen at the same time.
The corrosion of iron, which needs both oxygen and water; salt speeds it up.
Barrier methods (painting, oiling, galvanising) and sacrificial protection using a more reactive metal.
A ranking of metals by reactivity; a more reactive metal can sacrificially protect a less reactive one.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Redox, Rusting & Iron — a core area of GCSE Chemistry.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Redox, Rusting & Iron brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Redox, Rusting & Iron.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
